description.value: Kinton Ramen is a Canadian ramen chain with over 50 locations, serving authentic Japanese-style ramen with pork, beef, chicken, and vegetarian broths at their newly opened McArthurGlen Designer Outlet YVR location in Richmond. The brand is known for its customizable bowls — diners choose soup base, flavour (original, shoyu, miso, or spicy), and noodle type — and for greeting every guest with the Japanese welcome 'irasshaimase.' The outlet location is situated within a large designer shopping complex near the YVR airport corridor.
